message:
The other day, I found myself reminiscing about the simple joys of my childhood—playing outside, building forts, and exploring the world around me. It got me thinking about how important it is to equip ourselves with some basic safety skills, just like we did back then. 

There’s a wonderful resource that offers practical tips for emergency preparedness without any fuss. It’s a gentle reminder that sometimes, the best way to stay ready is to embrace those low-tech skills we might have forgotten. 

What’s a simple skill you learned as a child that you still cherish today?
